summary: Backend-only review of Sep 19 2026 P0 SAP integration fixes (Test Full Automated GRN async refactor + Supplier PO fetch parallelization). Per review-request instruction, NO real 'Test Full Automated GRN' POST was issued (already live-verified this session). Verified via (a) server startup health + smoke calls (/api/version 200, /api/supplier-portal/me 200), (b) code-level inspection of the 5 files-of-reference, (c) 1 live speed test against the read-only Supplier PO endpoint. All 3 pytest tests PASS. Vendor RAD-P2-S (Radish Technology, 168 POs) came back in 9.65s vs. the previously reported 20-25s - clears the <12s target.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_playwright_supplier_pgr_service.create_and_release_inbound_delivery_notifications (lines 953-1041) confirmed non-blocking: per-PO loop is exactly {idempotency pre-check (find_confirmation_rows) -> single maintain_bundle(release=True)}. No asyncio.sleep, no retry loop, no Put Away confirm, no Inbound Delivery ID lookup inline anymore. Docstring explicitly documents the earlier ~60s regression and why both slow steps were moved out.

server.py _start_full_auto_grn_job (lines 8768-8804) has the correct ordering: (1) create+release notifications, (2) finalize_goods_receipt, (3) job_store.update_job -> status 'done' with the result attached, (4) THEN asyncio.create_task(_auto_finish_full_auto_grn(...)) - the job's 'done' state does not depend on the background task's success. Also only fires the background task if at least one PO is 'posted', which is correct.

_auto_finish_full_auto_grn (lines 8709-8765) runs 4 attempts x 30s sleep = up to ~2 min lag tolerance for both Put Away confirm and Inbound Delivery ID lookup. Fully wrapped in try/except (returns silently on shipment fetch failure) - fire-and-forget as intended. Correctly reuses the same manually_confirm_inbound_delivery path the manual 'Fetch from SAP' button uses.

supplier_shipment_service.mark_put_away_confirmed (lines 1511-1522) correctly uses the MongoDB positional operator with the array-element filter in the query ({..., 'sap_gr_result.per_po.po_number': po_number} + $set on 'sap_gr_result.per_po.$.put_away_confirmed' / '.$.events'). Only patches those 2 fields - does NOT touch status, inbound_delivery_id, or any sibling per_po entries. Verified by inspection.

sap_po_analytics_client.fetch_open_po_quantities (lines 64-115) uses ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=SAP_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=3), and each worker still enters `with sap_semaphore:` so the global 3-concurrent-SAP-calls cap is honored end-to-end (no chance of blowing past it just because this call parallelizes). Result-merge into `results` dict is safe (dict.setdefault + assignment per PO/item key, no cross-chunk overlap since chunking is by PO number).

Live speed check: /api/supplier-portal/purchase-orders?as_vendor=RAD-P2-S returned 168 POs in 9.65s (measured post-warmup). Comfortably under the 12s target and a clear improvement over the 20-25s baseline the review request cited.

Startup: backend restarted cleanly (uptime shown in supervisor), no import errors, /api/version and /api/supplier-portal/me both 200. Nothing in supervisor/backend.err.log indicates a problem with the new SAPSiteLogisticsQueryClient/SAPSiteLogisticsManageClient instantiations at server.py:333-338 or the new _auto_finish_full_auto_grn / _confirm_put_away_task / mark_put_away_confirmed functions.

Minor (not blocking, not new to this session): SUPPLIER_PORTAL_TESTING_MODE is still 'true' in backend/.env, which enables the ?as_vendor= override on the Supplier Portal endpoints. Review request explicitly flagged this file as safe to test with, and _effective_vendor_code's own comment already says 'REMOVE THIS OVERRIDE ENTIRELY BEFORE LAUNCH' - just calling it out so it isn't forgotten.
